The thesis “Personal AI will define the next decade. The question is what it will do for humanity.” Soon everyone will have an AI that knows their emails, calendar, health and relationships. That much context demands trust. RHISE AI builds Lucie in Europe: hosted in the EU, with no ads, your data used only for you, and no training on your conversations. One personal AI for a whole life, across five pillars. Based in Amsterdam, Chris began in tech at InfoSeek, an early search engine acquired by Disney, and has served in CFO, COO, board, and advisory roles across AI, venture-backed startups, and impact organizations. At RHISE AI, he leads financial strategy, fundraising execution, cap table management, investor reporting, legal oversight, and operational discipline. Previously Disney Marvel BNP Paribas The Yope Foundation Education The Wharton School ✕ Andy Loy Co-founder & CEO · Germany LinkedIn ↗ Website ↗ WEF ↗ Wikipedia ↗ Andy is Co-founder & CEO of RHISE AI and a serial AI entrepreneur. After dropping out of a Master’s program at Stanford, he founded and scaled KONUX, an industrial AI company, to a $750M+ valuation and raised $200M+ across Europe and the US. A member of the World Economic Forum Global AI Council, Andy brings category-creation experience, responsible AI leadership, and a deeply personal mission shaped by his own health journey: building Lucie to put humans back at the center of technology. Previously KONUX World Economic Forum The Yope Foundation Earth Child Project Education Stanford University Technical University of Munich ✕ Samy Samandjeu Co-founder & CGO · London, United Kingdom LinkedIn ↗ Website ↗ Samy is Co-founder & CGO of RHISE AI, leading growth, product narrative, and go-to-market for Lucie. Originally from Banja, Cameroon, he studied finance, M&A, and private equity at Harvard and HEC Lausanne, and previously founded Creativesapp, a fintech AI platform for creators. Samy is also the author of Positive Focus, a philosophy on channeling attention toward abundance, wellness, and impact, the personal mission that now shapes Lucie’s human-centered growth movement. Previously Creativesapp Positive Focus Education Harvard Business School HEC Lausanne Cass Business School ✕ Danil Gontovnik Co-founder & CTO · United Kingdom LinkedIn ↗ Website ↗ Danil is Co-founder, CTO of RHISE AI. A former Meta engineer, he began building consumer apps in 2016, joined MSQRD before its acquisition by Facebook, and spent four years at Meta working on face filters and consumer AI experiences. He has built and sold multiple large-scale B2C apps, including NOJI, an AI exam-prep product acquired in 2025. At Lucie, Danil leads the technical architecture, AI systems, privacy foundations, and product execution behind Lucie, the Personal AI for what matters.
